compiled_state.title: Update sc-coverage-haiku/sonnet/opus prompts to scope only ## Success Criteria (stop at ## Closure Checks)
compiled_state.author: Test
compiled_state.description:
## Task

Update all three SC-coverage prompt files so LLM evaluators do not accidentally include ## Closure Checks items in coverage counts.

## Files to Modify

- plugins/dso/skills/sprint/prompts/sc-coverage-haiku.md
- plugins/dso/skills/sprint/prompts/sc-coverage-sonnet.md
- plugins/dso/skills/sprint/prompts/sc-coverage-opus.md

## Change Required

Add an explicit scoping instruction to each prompt file. The instruction must make clear:
- Only items listed under `## Success Criteria` are included in the coverage check
- If the ticket body contains a `## Closure Checks` section, do NOT include those items in coverage
- Stop reading the ticket description when `## Closure Checks` heading is encountered

Place the instruction prominently in the Task/Evaluation Rules section of each file (after the role description, before or within the task instructions).

## Instruction Text to Add

Add a bolded note such as:

> **Scoping rule**: Only items listed under `## Success Criteria` count as SCs. If the ticket body contains a `## Closure Checks` section, do NOT include those items in your coverage check. Stop reading the ticket description at the `## Closure Checks` heading.

## Acceptance Criteria

- All 3 files contain "Closure Checks" and "Success Criteria" in scoping context
- The instruction is prominent (not buried at end)
- Phrasing is consistent across all 3 tiers

## Testing Mode

GREEN (implements the behavior; test T2 verifies this change)

## Done Definitions Satisfied

DD1, DD2, DD3
